sections.SUMMARY: Non-dual nectar past compare drunk quenches poison-fever. Bliss-method for Śiva-winning, great souls', Kṣema-king's pure treatise.

rasa.dominant: amṛta-śānta of quenched fever; maṅgala-śānta of pure treatise
rasa.sthayibhava: amṛta-śama at drunk nectar; śama at method pure
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is nectar-peace: told, drunk, quenched. Quenching relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: method, owner, purity. Purity relished.
